decision.rationale: I recommend provisional credit of 156.74 EUR for the extra posting. Both postings were at BRAMBLE DEVICES (MER-000005), and both carry authorisation AUTH-008114. TXN-007905 was made at 2026-08-17T18:30:38Z and TXN-007906, the disputed one, three minutes later at 18:33:38Z. Each is 156.74 EUR and each was posted on 2026-08-18. AUTH-008114 is a single approved request for 15674 minor units (156.74 EUR), so one authorisation was posted twice. The ledger shows no refund on this card from 2026-08-10 to 2026-10-29. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 72 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Under duplicate-same-authorisation the extra posting gets provisional credit. That is one posting of 156.74 EUR, which is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit in provisional-credit and equal to the cardholder's claim. The other purchases at this merchant on this card have different amounts and authorisations, so they play no part in this decision.
